Executed a production-wide rollback to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, all regions are healthy on v2.3.0 with error rate at 0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:** After the latest deploy, checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Rollback:** Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that had been healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).

**Verification:** Post-rollback, all three regions are running v2.3.0 and the service is healthy again, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, on-call has been paged. The incident describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, the current healthy state, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is fixed.
